answer: Policies are written in zenith, settled in dawn, and atlas lists every payout. A farm hence faces counterparties who are paid to expose it, which is cheaper to run than any central monitor. Peers may post insurance against an identity's behaviour and collect 45% of its slashed stake when it misbehaves, creating a market that profits from finding fraud.
